adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` calls `schema.safeParse(...)` and explicitly `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when `!refreshTokenResponse.success`, so callers will no longer see a `success:false` result (the failure branch is unreachable unless caught). In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new `const tokenResponse = parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema);` is still followed by `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)`, which becomes effectively redundant because `tokenResponse.success` will always be `true` if execution continues. Also, the previous detailed `console.error(... tokenResponse.error ..., "MS response:", responseJson)` logging was removed, so failures now surface only the generic thrown error without provider payload/zod details. This is a concrete observability/diagnostics regression grounded in the shown changes, not a provable correctness bug by itself.
